div.head: I Cn 6a
div.ab: ⁊ huruþinga Godes þeowas – bisceopas ⁊ abbodas, munecas ⁊ mynecena, canonicas ⁊ nunnan – to rihte gebugan ⁊ regollice libban ⁊ dæges ⁊ nihtes oft ⁊ gelome clypian to Criste ⁊ for eall Cristen folc þingian georne.

⁊ huruðinga Godas þeowas — biscopas ⁊ abbodas, munecas ⁊ mynecena, canonicas ⁊ nunnan — to rihte gebugan ⁊ reollice libban ⁊ dæiges ⁊ nihtes oft ⁊ gelome clypian to Criste ⁊ for eal Cristen folc þingian georne.

⁊ huruþinga Godes þeowas, biscopas ⁊ abbodas, munecas ⁊ minicena, canonicas ⁊ nunnan to rihte gebugan ⁊ regollice libban ⁊ dæges ⁊ nihtes oft ⁊ gelome clipian to Criste ⁊ for eal Cristen folc þingian georne.
Et saltem ministri Domini, pontifices, abbates, monachi, monachę, canonici, nunnę regulariter uiuant, diebus ac noctibus sepius et assidue clament ad Deum pro Christiani necessitate populi;

⁊ huruþinga Godes þeowas—bisceopas ⁊ abbodas, munecas ⁊ mynecena, canonicas ⁊ nunnan—to rihte gebugan ⁊ regollice libban ⁊ dæges ⁊ nihtes oft ⁊ gelome clypian to Criste ⁊ for eall Cristen folc þingian georne.

And most of all the servants of God—bishops and abbots, monks and nuns, canons and women under religious vows—shall submit to their duty and live according to their rule, and day and night frequently and often call upon Christ and zealously intercede for all Christian people.

und vor allen Dingen sollen Gottesdiener — Bischöfe und Äbte, Mönche und Mönchinnen, Stiftsgeistliche und Nonnen — der Rechtspflicht sich unterwerfen und nach [kanonischer] Regel leben und bei Tage und Nacht oft und emsig zu Christo rufen und eifrig für alles Christenvolk Fürbitte thun.

and above all let the servants of God — bishops and abbots, monks and nuns [of a rule], canons and nuns — submit to their duty and live according to the rule, and by day and night often and frequently call to Christ and pray eagerly for all Christian people.
div.note: Liebermann compares VI Atr 2.2; V Atr 4.1.
